name: Wealth management
aboutParagraphs: A single advisor who sees your whole financial picture: investments, property, pensions, tax and estate. We build one written plan, review it twice a year, and adjust it when your life changes rather than when the market does. Suited to households and founders with complex finances.

name: Investment portfolios
aboutParagraphs: Globally diversified portfolios built from low-cost funds and rebalanced automatically. You choose from five risk levels, see every holding and every fee in your dashboard, and receive a plain-language report each quarter. No lock-in period and no performance fees.

name: Private banking
aboutParagraphs: Current and savings accounts in multiple currencies, a named relationship banker you can call directly, and priority access to lending and foreign exchange. Designed for clients who want their day-to-day banking handled with the same care as their investments.

name: Retirement planning
aboutParagraphs: We model your income, savings and pensions to show what retirement realistically looks like, then set a contribution plan to close any gap. Includes pension consolidation, drawdown strategy and yearly check-ins so the plan keeps pace with your life.

name: Business banking
aboutParagraphs: Business current accounts, international payments, payroll integration and cash-sweep tools that put idle balances to work. A business specialist helps you plan working capital, so finance supports your growth instead of slowing it down.

name: Lending and mortgages
aboutParagraphs: Residential mortgages, buy-to-let finance and secured credit lines assessed on your whole balance sheet, not a single payslip. Decisions are made by people who understand complex income, with clear terms and no early repayment surprises.
